import sys,tarfile,os,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);generated=root/'generated';items=[]
for role in ['ctl','a','b','c']:
 base=generated/('meta' if role=='ctl' else 'dfs-'+role+'-r1')/'etc'
 tar=root/'stage'/(role+'-config.tar')
 assert not tar.exists();files=[x for x in base.rglob('*') if x.is_file()];assert all(not x.is_symlink() for x in files)
 with tarfile.open(tar,'w') as a:
  for f in files:a.add(f,arcname=str(f.relative_to(base)),recursive=False)
 tar.chmod(0o600);os.chown(tar,int(os.environ['SUDO_UID']),int(os.environ['SUDO_GID']))
 items.append({'role':role,'tar':str(tar),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(tar.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'files':{str(f.relative_to(base)):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}})
print(json.dumps(items,indent=2))
